# Draft:Edward Overman

Edward Overman was an architect in the United States. Portsmouth, Virginia. He designed the Pythian Castle in Portsmouth, Virginia. In addition to business buildings and residences he worked on bridges.
He grew up in Norfolk County where he attended the public schools. Norfolk, Virginia
He designed a hosiery mill and dye works on North High Street by the Norfolk and Portsmouth Belt Line railroad in 1908. He was described as "of Portsmouth".
Works
*Pythian Castle (Portsmouth, Virginia) (1897-1898)
*Seaboard Building (1908), renovation
*John S. Wise residence
*Joseph A. Parker business block
*Knights of Pythias building in Hampton, Virginia*Merchants' and Farmers' Bank*Jidge L. R. Watts block in Norfolk
*Home on Churchland
*School building in Norfolk (1904)
